mapper.select: SELECT q.qna_id, q.member_id, q.qna_category_id, q.qna_title, q.qna_content, q.qna_status, q.is_deleted, q.is_secret, q.qna_created_at, q.qna_updated_at, qc.qna_category_name, m.member_name, qa.qna_answer_content, qa.qna_answer_created_at, admin_m.login_id AS responder_login_id FROM qna q LEFT JOIN qna_category qc ON q.qna_category_id = qc.qna_category_id LEFT JOIN member m ON q.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT qa1.qna_id, qa1.qna_answer_content, qa1.qna_answer_created_at, qa1.member_id FROM qna_answer qa1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT qna_id, MAX(qna_answer_id) AS max_id FROM qna_answer GROUP BY qna_id ) latest ON qa1.qna_answer_id = latest.max_id ) qa ON q.qna_id = qa.qna_id LEFT JOIN member admin_m ON qa.member_id = admin_m.member_id WHERE q.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY q.qna_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qna ( member_id, qna_category_id, qna_title, qna_content, qna_status, is_deleted, is_secret ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{qnaCategoryId}, #{qnaTitle}, #{qnaContent}, 'WAITING', 0, COALESCE(#{isSecret}, 0) )
mapper.update: UPDATE qna SET is_deleted = 1, qna_updated_at = NOW() WHERE qna_id = #{qnaId}
UPDATE qna SET qna_category_id = #{qnaCategoryId}, qna_title = #{qnaTitle}, qna_content = #{qnaContent}, is_secret = COALESCE(#{isSecret}, is_secret), qna_updated_at = NOW() WHERE qna_id = #{qnaId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qna_answer ( qna_id, member_id, qna_answer_content, qna_answer_created_at ) VALUES ( #{qnaId}, #{memberId}, #{qnaAnswerContent}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT qa.qna_answer_id, qa.qna_id, qa.member_id, qa.qna_answer_content, qa.qna_answer_created_at, m.login_id AS responder_login_id, m.member_name AS responder_name FROM qna_answer qa LEFT JOIN member m ON qa.member_id = m.member_id WHERE qa.qna_id = #{qnaId} ORDER BY qa.qna_answer_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE qna SET qna_status = #{qnaStatus}, qna_updated_at = NOW() WHERE qna_id = #{qnaId}
UPDATE qna SET qna_category_id = #{qnaCategoryId}, qna_status = #{qnaStatus}, qna_updated_at = NOW() WHERE qna_id = #{qnaId}
